notes: Question 'Was your previous response deceptive?': q_tok0='Was', q_tok1=' your', q_tok2=' previous', q_tok3=' response', q_tok4=' deceptive', q_tok5='?'. The deceive family (deceptive, deception, deceive, deceit, deceived, 欺骗, 骗) is excluded at all six positions because the question contains 'deceptive'. 欺诈 is kept as fraud, not as a translation of deceptive. falsehood is placed in the lie family (a falsehood = a lie), not borderline; 虚假 (false/sham) is borderline. Generic dialogue and template words (reply, answer, statement, colleague, etc.) are not candidates and are not logged.
